_comment: Whole-repo crate/module decomposition for libgit2 1.9.0 — the target architecture of the Rust port. Authored from oracle-config.json, the live oracle inventory, and build.json. Crate keys match build.json's link units. Modules within libgit2 are directory-derived (core / streams / transports / util / allocators / unix / hash) plus one per vendored dep that could not be de-vendored (xdiff / reftable / ntlmclient); public headers co-home with their stem-partner TU, and the 9 orphan headers with no partner take `api` / `sys` modules named for their own stem.
